pr.title: Rename message-agent to message and describe it in the README and on projector.bot
pr.head: 84e77be85983d763dd01370d8c5177d9fecbabf4

summary: Projector lets your coding-agent sessions find and message each other. This change makes that capability visible in the README and gives its skill the shorter name message.
The skill moves from skills/message-agent/ to skills/message/. Workflow references, the package contract, and the marketing site follow that move. Messaging behavior and key handling stay the same.

cards.title: Invoke the messaging skill
cards.html:
• Claude Code: /projector:message.
  • Codex: $message.
  • Across machines, the user creates and copies the shared key from a terminal.

groups.title: Expose the renamed skill
intro: Both agent hosts discover skills from the same directory tree. Renaming the directory and its frontmatter together makes message available to both hosts.
The review and fix workflows send peer-message handling to the renamed skill. Their ownership, delivery, and authority rules are unchanged.

files.note: The messaging workflow keeps its instructions and changes its published name.

checks.text: Compared the renamed file with the base: its messaging instructions are unchanged.

files.note: Fix workers refer peer-message handling to the renamed skill.
Review workers refer peer-message handling to the renamed skill.
Repository review routing points to the renamed skill.
The published skill contract expects message and checks its frontmatter and citations.

checks.text: All 14 packaging tests passed, including the published skill set, frontmatter names, and citations to other skills.

groups.title: Explain messaging to users
intro: The README introduces local messaging, cross-machine relay setup, and the rule that another agent cannot grant the user’s authority. The CLI reference identifies the renamed skill.

files.note: Lists the messaging skill and introduces registration, shared-key setup, and authority limits.

checks.text: Checked key setup against the CLI and relay documentation: export and import are terminal commands, and messaging uses shared-repository hidden refs.

files.note: Names the skill message beside the existing command reference.

groups.title: Use the skill on the website
intro: The marketing page shows an example request to the messaging skill beside the work and cleanup examples. Its documentation link now opens the renamed skill.

files.note: Provides the renamed skill’s repository URL.
Shows the message invocation and links the messaging card to its skill instructions.

checks.text: Lint, type-check, and production build passed. The built home page contains this invocation and the renamed skill URL.
